# Devashish Trehan

> Senior Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience building production-grade web applications.

## Skills

React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, frontend architecture, performance optimization, and responsive web development.

## Projects

- [WPT Play](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-play): A poker platform providing players with an online gaming experience.
- [World Poker Tour](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt): The official website of the World Poker Tour.
- [College Disha](https://devtrehan.in/projects/college-disha): An education platform offering career and college guidance.
- [Sosh Nft](https://devtrehan.in/projects/sosh-nft): An NFT-focused digital platform.
- [Casino Lobby](https://devtrehan.in/projects/casino-lobby): A configurable casino lobby displaying games, banners, and dynamic content.
- [Casino CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/casino-cms): A CMS for managing casino content, games, banners, game-banners etc. and Plugin to generate lobbies
- [WPT Global](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-global): The official user-facing web platform of WPT Global.
- [WPTG CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wptg-cms): A customized Strapi CMS for managing WPT Global website content.
- [WPTG Promo](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wptg-promo): A promotional platform for presenting WPT Global campaigns and offers.
- [WPT CMS](https://devtrehan.in/projects/wpt-cms): A customized Strapi CMS for managing World Poker Tour website content.
- [My Portfolio](https://devtrehan.in/projects/dev-portfolio): A personal portfolio showcasing my frontend development experience and projects.
- [Distinct](https://devtrehan.in/projects/distinct): A live data intelligence platform that captures and analyzes customer interactions at events.
- [GamaVrs](https://devtrehan.in/projects/gamavrs): An administration dashboard for managing a game avatar marketplace.
- [Moments NFT](https://devtrehan.in/projects/moment-nft): An NFT auction platform for digital collectibles.
